attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_lf_003
steps:
  - id: receive_cleaned_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: trigger.payload
      fields:
        - sections
        - tts_rate
        - tts_pitch
        - inter_section_pause_ms
    output: cleaned_input

  - id: split_sentences
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{cleaned_input.sections}}"
      sub_step:
        id: split_section
        op: transform_json
        params:
          input: "{{item}}"
          strategy: sentence_tokenize
          locale: fr-FR
    output: sections_with_sentences

  - id: create_utterances
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{sections_with_sentences}}"
      sub_step:
        id: build_utterance_per_sentence
        op: loop_records
        params:
          collection: "{{item.sentences}}"
          sub_step:
            id: build_single_utterance
            op: transform_json
            params:
              input: "{{item}}"
              template:
                type: SpeechSynthesisUtterance
                text: "{{item}}"
                lang: fr-FR
                rate: "{{cleaned_input.tts_rate}}"
                pitch: "{{cleaned_input.tts_pitch}}"
                section_index: "{{parent.index}}"
                sentence_index: "{{index}}"
    output: utterance_groups

  - id: insert_inter_section_pauses
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: insert_pause_between_groups
      collection: "{{utterance_groups}}"
      pause_ms: "{{cleaned_input.inter_section_pause_ms}}"
      pause_type: silent_utterance
    output: utterance_queue

  - id: queue_to_speech_api
    op: send_to_queue
    params:
      queue_name: web_speech_api
      items: "{{utterance_queue}}"
      api: SpeechSynthesis.speak
      native_browser: true
    output: playback_handle

  - id: highlight_on_utterance_start
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      event: utterance.onstart
      source: "{{playback_handle}}"
      action:
        highlight:
          target_selector: "[data-section='{{event.section_index}}'][data-sentence='{{event.sentence_index}}']"
          css_class: tts-active-sentence
        scroll_into_view:
          target_selector: "[data-section='{{event.section_index}}'][data-sentence='{{event.sentence_index}}']"
          behavior: smooth
          block: center
      repeat: true
    output: highlight_sync_status
